specimen_selection.rule: Lowest-index frozen UF250 source excluding UF250_020 with matching nontrivial WL1/WL2 cell and frozen E3 generator graph equal to the full symmetric group generators on that cell.

forbidden_after_seal: new symmetry search outside the three frozen generator checks

primary_interface_language.name: OR_OF_CANONICAL_RESIDUAL_CSP_ORBIT_BRANCHES
primary_interface_language.exact_orbit_identity_requirement: All raw assignments with the same Hamming weight must have canonically identical residual CSP semantics.

semantic_auditor.name: CANONICAL_ROBDD
semantic_auditor.variable_order: ascending numeric boundary variable id; frozen before outcome
purpose: compile the exact OR-of-residual-CSP interface without enumerating the boundary cube
decide whether R_C is constant TRUE/FALSE
construct exact unary projections by ROBDD restriction
construct the Cartesian product of unary projections
prove genuine joint correlation iff ROBDD(R_C) != ROBDD(product of unary projections)

polynomial_accounting.internal_assignment_enumeration: Exactly 2^3 = 8 frozen-cell assignments; constant for this scoped gate.
polynomial_accounting.residual_build: linear in local relation tuple surface times 8
polynomial_accounting.orbit_compression: four Hamming-weight representatives after exact residual identity checks
polynomial_accounting.bdd_accounting: measured against frozen quadratic node and quartic operation envelopes

precedence: FAIL_NONLOCAL_INFORMATION_REQUIRED if frozen S3 generator checks or within-orbit residual identities fail
FAIL_TRIVIAL_ESCAPE if any raw internal assignment yields exact TRUE residual, or final relation is constant TRUE/FALSE
FAIL_CLOSURE_BLOWUP if ROBDD node/operation bounds are exceeded
FAIL_UNARY_FACTORIZATION if exact relation equals product of unary projections
PASS_NONTRIVIAL_CORRELATED_BRIDGE otherwise, subject to independent replay
pass_conditions: sealed reduced hash matches frozen authority
each frozen generator transposition is an exact automorphism of sealed reduced CSP
all 8 raw residual branches are constructed
ROBDD interface is neither TRUE nor FALSE
ROBDD interface differs from exact product of unary projections
ROBDD size and operation counters stay within frozen polynomial envelopes
independent checker rebuilds interface and ROBDD without importing candidate
next_if_pass: Preregister MANTEQUILLA_DETECTION_TO_POLYNOMIAL_EXACT_CLOSURE_CERTIFICATE_GATE on a fresh unseen exact-symmetry specimen, then MANTEQUILLA_COMPOSITION_WITHOUT_EXPONENTIAL_PRODUCT_GATE.
next_if_fail: Freeze the exact failure class (trivial escape, unary factorization, representation blowup, or nonlocal information) before changing the language.
